description: In WebKitGTK 2.52.6 (Even simulator engine) streaming Silero VAD runs at RTF 2.1 (~69 ms per 512-sample session.run) through the app's engines, while Moonshine's large kernels are fine and Node runs the same build fast. ort-env.ts loads the asyncify (native WebGPU) build for every worker, including the CPU-only audio worker. Measure Silero per-call time in WebKitGTK with: asyncify build (current), plain ort-wasm-simd-threaded build, and jsep; isolate JS-side per-call overhead. JSC is also the iOS WebView engine. Output: numbers and a recommendation.
title: Measure ORT non-asyncify WASM build for the audio worker in WebKitGTK
